title: Photoshop basics
description:
• What will you learn here?

In this course, you will take your first steps in the world of Photoshop. First, you will learn about the program interface and how to customize it, then you will go deeper into the basic program tools and then move on to coloring methods, how to improve and merge images, as well as learn the steps to use filters, shapes and more.

Used software: Adobe P
